nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: Oi! This is my alley. Whatever it is you want, I don't have it.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: ...You're the husband, aren't you. I seen your face on the street earlier.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: You were here tonight. You see everything that passes through this alley. Tell me who was here.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: I don't want no trouble, mate. What I saw — that ain't the sort of thing a man talks about freely.

choices.text: [I have money. Here, take it.] Two shillings. More if what you tell me is useful.
[Steady.] I'm not going to hurt you. I just need to know who was near her tonight.
[Grab him.] You're not going anywhere until you tell me what you saw.
[Dark.] I will make what happened in this alley tonight look gentle if you don't talk to me right now.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: Alright. Alright. There was a man. Well-dressed. Coat and hat, proper gentleman. He went in after her. Came out quick.
nodes.journal_entry: A well-dressed man followed Clara into the alley and left quickly. This was not random.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: ...There was a man. Toff, by the look of him. Nice coat. He followed her in. I — I should have done something. I know.
nodes.journal_entry: A well-dressed man followed Clara into the alley and left quickly. This was not random.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: Alright, alright! A man! Gentleman's coat, top hat. He followed her in. Was out again inside two minutes. That's all I know, I swear it.
nodes.journal_entry: A well-dressed man followed Clara into the alley and left quickly. This was not random.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: Please — please. There was a man. Rich. Real proper gentleman. Followed her in, left in a hurry. I didn't see his face. Please.
nodes.journal_entry: A well-dressed man followed Clara into the alley and left quickly. This was not random.

nodes.speaker: Mickey Daws
nodes.text: There was something else. He was carrying something when he came out. Small. Like papers, maybe. Or a book.
nodes.journal_entry: The man took something from Clara. Papers. Or a book. What did she have?
